NOTE
**Still not ready — self-review checklist is still missing from the PR description**

New: The author split the work into three focused commits, added videos for each UI change, added a test file and auto-fill tests, and filled in the description, testing notes and "Fixes #20316". Missing: the PR template's self-review checklist isn't in the description, and CI status can't be confirmed from here, so the "all checks pass" claim is unverified.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" on the PR, and have laurynmm confirm once the checklist is added; then remove "not ready", add "maintainer review", and assign laurynmm.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for splitting up the commits and adding the videos, that helps a lot. The PR description is still missing the self-review checklist from the [PR template](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html), so please add it and go through each item before we review.
```
